title: ModerationSettingsInput
description: Body of PUT /moderation-settings. Unknown keys are a 422.

streaming_moderation.description: How output moderation applies to streamed responses, organisation-wide: `buffered` scans the whole response before sending a byte (never leaks blocked content); `chunked` scans as tokens stream (lower latency, may disclose content before a block). A rule's own `streaming` overrides it. Unset reads as `buffered`.
